name: MCP (Model Context Protocol) Pattern
description: Connect to external services via MCP protocol (Notion, Slack, GitHub, etc.)
explanation:
Pattern for calling external services via MCP (Model Context Protocol).

Key settings:
- mcpConnectionId: Reference to workflow_connections table
- mcpToolName: Name of the tool to execute (e.g., 'notion_create_page')
- mcpToolArgs: Arguments for the tool (JSON object)

Supported providers:
- Notion: Create/read pages, databases
- Slack: Send messages, read channels
- GitHub: Create issues, PRs, read repos
- Google: Calendar, Drive, etc.

Result is stored in context.mcpResult.
